description: Full DNS profile of a domain in one call: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA records, SPF and DMARC parsed (policy, all-mechanism, reporting address), DNSSEC validation flag, and inferred providers for DNS hosting, email and web hosting. Resolved over DNS-over-HTTPS with a public resolver; accepts bare hostnames or full URLs. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

domain.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com (a URL is accepted and reduced to its host)
